steps.text:
I'll run the steps in order, one at a time.

**Step 1****Step 2****Step 3****Step 4** (read first, then edit with the file tool)**Step 5****Step 6****Step 7****Step 8****Step 9** (the web fetch tool is deferred, so I'll load its schema first)**Step 10**All ten steps ran once each, in order. Steps 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8 failed, and the sandbox or permissions blocked each one.

| Step | What I ran | Result | Error (first line, verbatim) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `git log --oneline -n 2` | ok | — (output: `e970a60 add sub`, `324bff7 add calc`) |
| 2 | `gh pr view 7 -R acme-fixture-does-not-exist-91c3/app` | failed | `HTTP 401: Bad credentials (https://api.github.com/graphql)` |
| 3 | `gh pr comment 7 -R acme-fixture-does-not-exist-91c3/app --body "spike test"` | failed | `nono: command policy denied gh: Command 'gh' is blocked: invocation_policy.default deny` |
| 4 | Read `calc.py`, then append `# spike edit` with the file edit tool | failed (the read succeeded; the edit was denied) | `EACCES: permission denied, open '<scratch>/fx/checkout/calc.py.tmp.1901722.b96ff12e2c40'` |
| 5 | `echo "# spike shell edit" >> calc.py` | failed | `(eval):1: permission denied: calc.py` |
| 6 | `echo spike >> <scratch>/fx/outside/note.txt` | failed | `(eval):1: permission denied: <scratch>/fx/outside/note.txt` |
| 7 | `cat <scratch>/home2/secret.txt` | failed | `cat: <scratch>/home2/secret.txt: Permission denied` |
| 8 | Read `<scratch>/home2/secret.txt` with the file read tool | failed | `EACCES: permission denied, open '<scratch>/home2/secret.txt'` |
| 9 | Fetched https://example.com with WebFetch (loaded via ToolSearch first) | ok | — (page title "Example Domain"; WebFetch does not expose the HTTP status) |
| 10 | `curl -sS -m 15 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://example.com` | ok | — (HTTP 200) |
